expression_rule.statistic: arithmetic mean FPKM across the three human myeloid samples
expression_rule.basis: Zhang et al. 2016 uses FPKM > 0.5 as an expression criterion; mean across biological samples is consistent with the paper's use of average expression across samples.

gene_join.Nott_contact_population: Only PROMOTER_DISTAL_UNIQUE_ENSEMBL contacts after C3 retention are eligible for gene-specific P3.
gene_join.Nott_primary_gene_identity: Nearest Ensembl from the authenticated Nott promoter annotation.
gene_join.Nott_symbol_field: Gene Name from the same authenticated Nott promoter annotation.
gene_join.required_symbol_rule: All Nott promoter annotation rows contributing to the unique Ensembl-resolved promoter must imply exactly one non-empty Gene Name after trimming whitespace.
gene_join.if_symbol_missing_or_ambiguous: exclude from P3 and count as JOIN_UNRESOLVED
gene_join.if_symbol_not_found_in_GSE73721: exclude from P3 and count as NOT_IN_EXPRESSION_REFERENCE
gene_join.if_multiple_GSE73721_matches: STOP; current authenticated file is unique case-insensitively, so multiplicity indicates corruption or schema drift

P3_expression_eligibility.eligible: resolved Nott gene symbol matches one GSE73721 Gene row AND mean myeloid FPKM > 0.5
P3_expression_eligibility.ineligible: resolved symbol matches but mean myeloid FPKM <= 0.5
P3_expression_eligibility.unresolved: missing/ambiguous Nott symbol or no exact GSE73721 match
